definitions.explanation: A narrow piece of land that extends into a body of water.

examples.japanese: {岬|みさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{灯台|とうだい}→灯台：04560_toudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a lighthouse at the tip of the cape.

examples.japanese: {岬|みさき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧。
examples.english: Look out over the sea from the cape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知床岬|しれとこみさき}→知床岬：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界遺産|せかいいさん}→世界遺産：04897_sekaiisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cape Shiretoko is registered as a World Heritage site.

notes:
{岬|みさき} refers to a point of land extending into water.

FAMOUS CAPES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{知床岬|しれとこみさき}→知床岬：noentry⟧ (Cape Shiretoko, Hokkaido)
- ⟦{潮岬|しおのみさき}→潮岬：noentry⟧ (Cape Shiono, southernmost point of Honshu)
- ⟦{足摺岬|あしずりみさき}→足摺岬：noentry⟧ (Cape Ashizuri, Shikoku)
- ⟦{佐多岬|さたみさき}→佐多岬：noentry⟧ (Cape Sata, southernmost point of Kyushu)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {岬|みさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around a cape)
- {岬|みさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧ (tip of the cape)
